items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I never know if Kid Clayton would play piano. They say he could play. I thought he played.

ctx.x: What did Kid Clayton play on? Kid Clayton play on piano. I never heard him play.
Kid Clayton. I never know if Kid Clayton would play piano. They say he could play. I thought he played. I thought he was a piano or trumpet man.
I heard he played like sheep.
